title: Poolside Assistant configuration
description: Configures ACP agent servers used by Poolside Assistant. Unknown properties are accepted for forward compatibility.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for validation and completion.

agent_servers.description: ACP agent servers keyed by the name shown in Poolside Assistant.

default_agent_server.description: Agent server selected for new conversations. Defaults to "poolside" when omitted.

default_agent_server_pinned.description: When true, the default_agent_server choice was explicitly pinned by the user and Poolside Assistant skips automatic updates to it (such as last-used tracking).

customAgentServer.title: Custom ACP agent server
customAgentServer.description: Starts a user-provided ACP agent executable.

type.description: Custom agent type. May be omitted because custom is the default.

command.description: Executable name or path. The command is started directly, without shell parsing.

args.description: Arguments passed verbatim to the executable.

env.description: Environment variables added to the agent process. Values are stored as plain text in assistant.json; do not put secrets here.

default_config_options.description: Agent-defined select option IDs and values to use as defaults for new sessions.

registryAgentServer.title: Registry-managed ACP agent server
registryAgentServer.description: Uses command and distribution metadata managed by Poolside's ACP registry.

default_config_options.description: Agent-defined select option IDs and values to use as defaults for new sessions.

localAgentServer.title: Poolside Local agent server
localAgentServer.description: Reserved for the Poolside Local on-device runtime configured by the desktop app.

pinnedConfigOptions.description: Config option IDs whose default_config_options value was explicitly pinned by the user. Poolside Assistant skips automatic updates (such as last-used tracking) for pinned options.
